name: 3D Pinball: Space Cadet
author: Gameblabla
description_short: A GameCube port of the classic 3D Pinball: Space Cadet table
description_long: Launch the ball, work the flippers, and nudge the table in this GameCube port of 3D Pinball: Space Cadet. The port supports sound effects and optional OGG music, but requires the original PC game's copyrighted graphics and audio assets, which are not included.

external_resources.label: Original 3D Pinball: Space Cadet assets
external_resources.notes: Required copyrighted graphics and sound assets are not distributed with the port. Supply them from a legally obtained copy of the original PC game and place all files in /apps/SpaceCadetPinball/Data/. Optional music must be named PINBALL.OGG and placed in the same directory.
